scope: Fixed-geometry failure-kernel theory; not RSA candidate screening or a new packing test.

certificate.method: Exact nonnegative Bernstein coefficients are sufficient, not necessary, on [0,1].

exact.convention: T=number of transitions including absorption; initial mass missing from rho is already absorbed at T=0. Moment Laurent exponents are exact algebra, not evidence of packing superiority.

forest.interpretation: Mean exponent is tree valuation minus eligible two-root-forest valuation; it is generally NOT shortest escape-path weight.

zeroEndpoint.convention: Infinite unconditional moments when nonabsorption has positive probability.
